roadNetwork.socketRule: one cardinal route neighbor on a straight segment; never diagonal or at a junction

exclusions.governmentBuildings: one-cell hard and three-cell tree clearance
exclusions.bridges: two-cell clearance around every terrain bridge cell
exclusions.pointsOfInterest: two-cell clearance around pads, portals and anchors
exclusions.vehicles: straight authored road sockets outside junctions and every functional exclusion
exclusions.streetFurniture: cardinal straight-route shoulders, outward offsets, tangent-aware yaw and two-cell landscape buffer
exclusions.terrainSteps: support footprints remain on one authored land elevation
exclusions.walkableMeshes: decorations are visual-only and never registered as walkable terrain
